topic: Device performance and data tracking issues
summary_markdown:
Discussion covered the status of several device firmware updates. Specifically, *DP_2* was noted as problematic due to uneven packet counts (though this smooths out daily) and local failures/real data drops relative to other devices. *DP_5*'s packet count stabilized after updating, but traffic (both real and local) is slightly declining compared to others.

Separately, an issue was raised regarding the lack of real-time map data for Mediateco. The conversation concluded with a note that coordinates were forgotten/missing.
decisions: The firmware version for DP_02 needs correction in the documentation.
action_items: Someone needs to provide the missing coordinates.
